title: QAmcp: check any MCP server before you install it
intro: MCP servers are plugins that give your AI new powers. Anyone can publish one, and your AI trusts it completely. QAmcp is a free, open-source tool that tests a server first and gives it a score out of 100. Real checks, no AI guessing.
reel: From the reel: Three things one free command checks before you install any MCP server.

tools.name: QAmcp
tools.what: Runs on your computer. Needs Node.js.

copy.label: Try it on the broken demo server first
Test a real server (put its link at the end)

tools.name: Code

sections.heading: What it checks
steps: Does it connect and answer properly?
Do its tools work, or does one never answer?
Security: hidden instructions, leaked passwords, and login.

note: Check it first. Then decide if your AI should trust it.
